initial:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one square Shoal app-brand icon concept, delivered as a transparent PNG.

Create a single friendly, rounded scallop seashell: a broad fan silhouette with 7–9 chunky raised ribs and a small hinge at the bottom. Give it slight three-quarter tactile depth while it mostly faces the camera. The shell is handmade stop-motion clay, matching cute sculpted sea-animal portraits: soft clay texture, restrained fingerprints, matte sculpted ridges, and softly rounded edges. Use warm pale peach and ivory on the shell with soft coral recesses. Keep the shape simple and recognizable at small icon scale.

Center the complete shell at approximately 80% of the square canvas, leaving comfortable transparent margins on every side. Render a clean, genuinely transparent PNG background with a real alpha channel. The shell itself must be fully opaque; transparency belongs only outside its silhouette. Use gentle studio lighting and subtle self-shading to reveal the clay ribs.

Exactly one shell. No square tile, no background color, no ocean scene, no sand, no ground plane, no extra objects, no eyes or face, no letters, no text, no logos, no watermark. Do not imitate transparency with a drawn checkerboard.
alpha_refinement:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied square PNG of one warm peach/ivory clay scallop seashell.

Keep the exact shell design, pose, framing, colors, tactile clay texture, rounded fan silhouette, chunky ribs, and small bottom hinge unchanged. Refine only the cutout and opacity.

Deliver a clean transparent PNG with a proper production-quality alpha mask. The ENTIRE shell interior must be fully opaque, alpha 255. No semitransparent patches anywhere inside the shell. Every background pixel outside the shell must be fully transparent, alpha 0. Allow partial alpha only on the very thin antialiased silhouette edge. Remove all isolated stray pixels outside the shell and all yellow, red, or white fringe artifacts along its outline; edge colors must naturally match the peach clay shell. Keep the complete shell and comfortable empty margins.

No new objects, no tile, no shadows outside the silhouette, no ground, no scene, no face, no letters or text. Preserve the one original shell as closely as possible; only repair transparency and the cutout edge.
final_opaque_background:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Create the final square Shoal app icon concept from the supplied clay scallop seashell image.

KEEP the single warm peach and ivory seashell: same broad rounded fan silhouette, 9 chunky raised ribs, small bottom hinge, soft coral recesses, matte handmade stop-motion clay texture, sculpted depth, and gentle studio lighting. No face or eyes.

CHANGE THE BACKGROUND ONLY: replace the entire grey checkerboard with ONE perfectly uniform warm off-white background, hex #F7F4EF. The finished PNG must be fully opaque everywhere. The background is a solid uninterrupted flat ivory field from edge to edge. Absolutely no checkerboard, no transparency, no alpha cutout, no grid, and no patterned background. Do not represent or illustrate transparency.

Keep the complete shell centered with clear margins on all four sides. No square tile inset, no border, no ocean scene, no sand, no ground plane, no extra objects, no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark. Deliver one polished usable square icon image.
